  692 |     """Return a list of normalized combinations for a `BCP 47` language tag.
  693 | 
  694 |     Example:
  695 | 
  696 |     >>> from docutils.utils import normalize_language_tag
  697 |     >>> normalize_language_tag('de_AT-1901')
  698 |     ['de-at-1901', 'de-at', 'de-1901', 'de']
  699 |     >>> normalize_language_tag('de-CH-x_altquot')
  700 |     ['de-ch-x-altquot', 'de-ch', 'de-x-altquot', 'de']
  701 | 
  702 |     """

  704 |     tag = tag.lower().replace('-', '_')
  705 | 
  706 |     tag = tag.lower()
  707 | 
  708 | 
  709 |     tag = tag.replace('-', '_', 1)
  710 | 
  711 | 
  712 |     tag = tag.replace('-', '_', 1)
  713 | 
  714 |     # split (except singletons, which mark the following tag as non-standard):
  715 |     tag = re.sub(r'_([a-zA-Z0-9])_', r'_\1-', tag)
  716 |     subtags = [subtag for subtag in tag.split('_')]
  717 |     base_tag = (subtags.pop(0),)
  718 |     # find all combinations of subtags
  719 |     taglist = []
